description: Add an app as one button with its icon. Pass its App Store or Google Play link (and the other store's link if it has one): stomp.to reads the name and icon. Visitors on iPhone go to the App Store, on Android to Google Play; computers see both.

endsAt.description: When it stops showing, ISO 8601 with a time zone, e.g. 2026-12-01T18:00:00-08:00. Ask the user's time zone if unsure. null clears it.

otherUrl.description: The same app's link on the other store, if it has one.

startsAt.description: When it starts showing, ISO 8601 with a time zone, e.g. 2026-12-01T18:00:00-08:00. Ask the user's time zone if unsure. null clears it.

url.description: The app's App Store or Google Play link.

name: add_app
title: Add an app button
